def rot_err_deg(a, b):
    Ra = rh.quat_to_mat(np.array(a[3:])); Rb = rh.quat_to_mat(np.array(b[3:]))
    return np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip((np.trace(Ra.T @ Rb)-1)/2, -1, 1)))
def go_corr(target, dur, held=False, err_prev=None, tol_mm=1.2, max_fix=2):
    target = np.array(target, float)
    cmd = target.copy()
    if err_prev is not None: cmd[:3] -= err_prev
    o = go(cmd, dur, held=held)
    if o is None: return None, err_prev
    for k in range(max_fix):
        a = np.array(o["robot"]["tcp_pose"]); err = a[:3] - target[:3]
        if np.linalg.norm(err[:2])*1000 <= tol_mm and abs(err[2])*1000 <= 2.5: break
        cmd = cmd.copy(); cmd[:3] -= err
        o2 = go(cmd, 0.8, held=held)
        if o2 is None: break
        o = o2
    a = np.array(o["robot"]["tcp_pose"]); err = a[:3] - target[:3]
    print("  final err_mm", np.round(err*1000,1), "rot_err_deg", round(rot_err_deg(a, target),2))
    return o, (cmd[:3] - target[:3]) * -1  # the compensation that was needed (as err to subtract next time)
